Tested data package → IntegrationSource level, index snapshot, rule version and acceptance are connected in the import manifest.

  1. To combine technical responsibilities of the workplaces with common rules, a well-kept manual and regular integration.
  2. Merge TEI, schema, scripts and register levels in designated packages; connect automatic checks and editorial review.
  3. Separately regulate expert opinions, publishers and public approval; agree on succession, restoration and permissible process analyses in advance.
Decision paths and data flows as text

The joint integration combines edition data, rule version and index snapshot in the band manifest. Expert reports and publishers receive each designated excerpts; technical corrections return in a controlled manner. Public data are released separately. A model or host change leads to re-examination and replaces no care allowance.
